entities.summary: John Gregory Branca is an American entertainment lawyer and manager who specializes in representing rock and roll acts. He is the co-executor of the estate of Michael Jackson and Chairman of The Michael Jackson Company. Branca has represented over 30 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductees including The Rolling Stones, Aerosmith, Bee Gees and The Doors.
